sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Fixes after alpha.47: shared interface scale, easier scrolling, a new composer and stable Miggi dragging.
Fresh install or install over the exact public alpha.47 package; memory stays V039. Direct upgrades from other older builds are not claimed.
Roman will check two-monitor capture and a real microphone on his main PC. This is a personal test alpha, not a stable release.

sections.heading: added
paragraphs: Shared 80–180% interface scale for chat, settings, files, statistics, diagnostics, updates and other app windows. Avatar size remains independent.
Settings now include Miggi size and interface scale; sections scroll together beneath a compact heading.
Thin scrollbars widen on hover and while dragging, with a larger hit area.
Voice input supports cancel, stop into a draft, and explicit transcribe-and-send. No duplicate buttons; long input and tools share one composer.

sections.heading: fixed
paragraphs: Corrected monitor-coordinate mapping for selected-region capture, including left and upper monitors; display-layout changes cancel stale selections.
Diagnostics retain safe capture error codes and stages without pictures, conversation text or keys.
Fixed confirmation text, diagnostic report readability, selection and coloured emoji rendering in Warm Linen without replacing characters.
Avatar dragging uses physical coordinates and DPI; expanded chat moves with it without accidental avatar resizing.
Quick input fades out smoothly; refined composer layout, history-edge fading and outdated reminder help text.

sections.heading: knownIssues
paragraphs: No Windows Authenticode signature. Do not bypass SmartScreen/SAC or disable protection. Update-channel signatures are not a Windows publisher signature.
Real two-monitor capture, microphone use and an installed alpha.47 → alpha.48 transition await manual acceptance. Dev and synthetic checks are not replacements.
The installer pins the exact public alpha.47 source. Older versions need their documented upgrade route; do not delete protected records to bypass refusal.
Portable full-Home backup and experimental recovery are not included. The app is free; AI requests are billed through your own API key.
